# Novapharm Innovation Technology

> Novapharm Innovation Technology is an India-based pharmaceutical development and technology partner operating from Vadodara, Gujarat.

Canonical website: https://nit.novapharmhealthcare.com/
Business development: bd@novapharmhealthcare.com

## What the company does

- Formulation and CMC development planning
- Technology transfer and manufacturing-readiness coordination
- Pharmaceutical portfolio and product-opportunity assessment
- Programme governance and technical coordination
- Early-stage destination-market requirement mapping with appropriately qualified specialists

## Important scope statements

- Website content is general information, not medical, legal, patent or formal regulatory advice.
- Formal laboratory, manufacturing, filing, licence-holder, local-representation and other regulated activities are performed by the appropriately qualified and appointed parties for each programme.
- References to markets or regulators do not imply an approval, licence, filing commitment or guaranteed outcome.
